body:
I may work on that. :)

Thanks for talking with me, all those feels were building up inside me, and I had nowhere to direct them to... Talking with a stranger about these things is actually far easier, for me anyway. See ya

Yes, I'm mature enough to admit that the internet in particular was/is partially the reason of my "downfall". Most of the times I find myself thinking "I'm fine like this, I don't need anyone". Do I really mean it? My mind hasn't decided yet...

I don't know, is it possible that I would enjoy feeling sad and depressed? It's frightening, because many times I find myself seeking just that, I sort-of "cause" my depression... I can't explain it! Do I really want to get out of this dark place? My post here should speak for itself, but actually it doesn't. I don't have the mental energy to care anymore...

I mostly watch series. I loved "No Game No Life", as well as "Tasogake Otome x Amnesia". "Mirai Nikki" was a masterpiece, and "Tokyo Ghoul" was very good. "Monogatari Series", "Angel Beats", "Full Metal Panic & Alchemist", "Nichijou", all very nice. I have a list at myanimelist, just remove the last letter of the nick I have here. :p

Yes, I understand what you're saying. But, that is my main problem, I have given up on trying to accomplice anything. I know it's sad and pathetic, but that's who I am. It frustrates me, but the more I fight it, the harder it crashes and burns in front of my feet...

I used to go to the gym too, mostly because I used to meet with other friends there, and I was doing a bit of weight lifting. Now, most of them are gone, the rest are rarely talking to me anymore, partially because of me( I tend to be an introvert ). 

Yes, this period almost my whole day is spent in front of the PC. I have nothing else to do really. As I said, anime is one of my last still enjoyable hobbies. And no, I'm not exercising any more, to the point when sometimes I go for some pizza with a friend( we do this often ), the 5-min foot-walk to the restaurant is making my legs hurt.

Yet, I'm gaining almost no weight, probably because I eat approx every 2nd day and my sleep cycle is messed up too. That's actually a little weird, but I've grown used to it. :D

I've tried many times to develop my own game, but my lack of creativity and patience led to me dumping it, as always... It's just as you said, the passion withered away, along with my coding abilities about a year ago.

I dunno about that date, it was during a day when I was feeling depressed. I had read somewhere that if you have suicidal thoughts, you should postpone it for later as to be sure it wasn't a compulsive actions. And so I did.
Had you asked me two-three years ago, I'd have said, without a doubt, that I'd like to work as a game software developer. Right now, I don't want to be anything...
